Here is the issue description:
# Values for MVENDORID, MARCHID and MIMPID
The values of  `MVENDORID`, `MARCHID` and `MIMPID` are currently as-cloned from IBEX.  The will need to be updated to match the CVE2 values.  A good example of these can be found in the CV32E40X User Manual ([link](https://docs.openhwgroup.org/projects/cv32e40x-user-manual/en/latest/control_status_registers.html#machine-vendor-id-mvendorid)).
